title: Onegai desu kara Uketekure
titleNative: お願いですからウケてくれ
synopsis: An entire year has passed since she entered high school, but Chikage Kurokawa is still an aggressively shy loner. In order to acquire friends, she endeavors to utilize the power of laughter—and thus she forms a laughter-bringing tag team with him, the unpopular Makoto Fujisawa!? The aim is a dramatic turnaround: leaving this loner-life behind! So, please laugh, please! (Source: Champion Cross, translated)

title: Danshi Koukousei, Otome Game no Akuyaku Reijou ni Tensei suru.

synonyms: A High School Boy Reincarnates as the Villainous Daughter in an Otome Game
synopsis: One day, "I," an ordinary high school boy living in the present day, was hit by a truck and reincarnated in another world. But what a surprise it was to find out that I was reincarnated as Elena Evan, the "villainess" of an otome game! If this continues, the future that awaits me will either be condemnation, execution, or exile... I want to avoid that at all costs. While I was worrying about this, I found a glimmer of hope. If Tiara, the main heroine, and I could get together and find a yuri route for us, maybe we could avoid a bad ending...? However, I am now beset by a number of beautiful and handsome men?! (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

synopsis: Umiko, a grandma, realizes that she has the same desire to make movies as university student Kai—and soon she enrolls in Kai's film school! "It's not the movies you like…you like watching the people watching the movies." Just what are you going to do with the rest of your life? It's the question you'll always have to answer, no matter your age. Umiko Chino is a 65-year-old retired woman in mourning for her late husband. Remembering how they used to watch films together, Umiko goes to the movie theater for the first time in years, where she meets Kai, an attractive, ambiguous young man who studies filmmaking at a nearby art school. They would seem to have nothing in common, except for this—both of them sometimes like to look more at the way the audience reacts to a movie than the movie itself. Kai believes Umiko has the same deep desire he possesses to experience how people respond to something they made… and challenges her to stake the rest of her life discovering that thrill. Soon Umiko surprises herself by enrolling in the same film school as Kai. synopsis: "I pray every day that this love dies, that I may love you only until today, and that tomorrow this love will be dead." Thalia Roem Gürta, the ill-fated princess born of an affair. She grows up distorted amidst indifferent parents, hostile half-siblings, and servants who despise her. Thalia has protected herself by raising her thorns against everyone who approaches. Yet, even she becomes defenseless in the presence of one person. He is none other than the Prince of the East, Varkas Raedgo Sheerkan. Forced to be perfect as a retainer of the imperial court and the heir to the Grand Duke, he grew up with most of his emotions numb under discipline bordering on abuse. A man who exists solely for the honor and duty of his family. To keep a promise made to the late Empress, he enters into a marriage with Thalia's half-sister, Ayla, and Thalia, engulfed in despair, slowly falls apart. However, her love, destined for death, faces an unexpected turning point.... (Source: KakaoPage, translated)
